services.metaDesc: Bed bug, cockroach, rodent and termite control in Nairobi and across Kenya. Inspection first, 90-day guarantee, from KSh 3,500. Book on WhatsApp.
services.h1: Pest Control and Fumigation Services in Nairobi
services.audience: Homes, landlords, Airbnbs, offices and restaurants
services.lead: Stermont Arcade provides pest control and fumigation for homes, landlords, Airbnb hosts, offices and restaurants in Nairobi and across Kenya. We treat bed bugs, cockroaches, rodents and termites, and every job starts with an inspection so the treatment matches the pest and the property, not a one-size-fits-all spray.
includes: Bed bug treatment for beds, mattresses, sofas, skirting and wall cracks, using low-odour products wherever the pest allows
Cockroach control with gel baiting in kitchens, drains and cabinets
Termite soil treatment around foundations, door frames and timber
Rodent control for rats and mice, including entry-point advice
Pre-inspection with a clear explanation of what we found before we treat
A 90-day service guarantee: if the pest returns in the guarantee period, tell us and we follow up
process: Tell us about the problem
Message us on WhatsApp or call. Say which pest you see, where, and how long it has been happening. Photos help.
Inspection
We inspect the property, confirm the pest and the extent of the infestation, and give you a quote before any work starts.
Treatment
We treat the affected areas with the method that suits the pest: gel baiting for cockroaches, targeted treatment for bed bugs, soil treatment for termites, bait and proofing advice for rodents.
Aftercare
We explain how long to stay out of treated rooms, what to clean and what to leave, and how to stop the pest coming back.
Follow-up
If the problem returns within the guarantee period, contact us and we come back to deal with it.
factors: The pest: bed bugs, cockroaches, rodents and termites need different methods and different numbers of visits.
The size of the property and the number of rooms or units treated.
How severe and how old the infestation is.
Access: ceiling voids, soil around foundations and shared walls in apartments take longer.
services.areas: We operate from the Sarit Centre in Westlands, Nairobi, and serve homes and businesses across Nairobi. We also take jobs in other counties; confirm your town on WhatsApp and we will confirm availability and any travel cost.
faqs: How much does pest control cost in Nairobi?

Typical jobs run from KSh 3,500 to KSh 25,000 depending on the pest, the size of the property and how severe the problem is. We give you a firm quote after the inspection, before any treatment starts.
How do I get rid of bed bugs?

Bed bugs hide in mattresses, bed frames, sofas and wall cracks, so one spray rarely solves it. We inspect, treat every hiding place and give aftercare advice such as washing bedding on a hot cycle. Read our bed bug guide for what you can do before we arrive.
Is it safe to stay in the house after fumigation?
Follow the re-entry time we give you for each treated room. We explain it on the day. Keep children, pets and food away from treated areas until then.
What does the 90-day guarantee cover?
If the pest we treated comes back within 90 days, contact us and we follow up. Ask us for the exact terms when you book so you know what is covered.
Do you treat Airbnbs, offices and restaurants?
Yes. We work with landlords, Airbnb hosts, offices and restaurants, and we can plan visits around your opening hours.

faqs: How much does solar installation cost in Kenya?

Our solar jobs start from about KSh 15,000 for small setups and go beyond KSh 250,000 for larger systems. The final price depends on the number of panels, the inverter and the battery. We quote after we know your loads.
What size solar system do I need?
It depends on what you run and for how long. A few lights and a phone charger need far less than a fridge, TV and water pump. Tell us your appliances and we size the system for you.
Do you install lithium batteries?
Yes. Lithium battery wiring and set-up is part of our solar service.
Can you service a solar system someone else installed?
Yes. We check panels, wiring, the inverter and the battery on existing systems and tell you what needs fixing.
